title: Starter Pulse Tour — visual variants and microcopy for first-run checklist
creator: Marcus Li
description: Design and asset set for a compact, non-intrusive first-run "starter pulse" tour in the Redwood Console. The starter pulse is an animated micro-spotlight that appears next to key console entry points (Projects, Models, Keys) and surfaces a 3-step checklist, contextual tips, and an empty-state CTA. This ticket consolidates visual variants, microcopy A/B candidates, accessibility notes, export-ready artboards, and reference screenshots for the release pipeline.
artifacts: Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e-starter-pulse-assets (SVG exports, Lottie json, sprite sheets)
screenshots: sp-landing-01.png — landing page with pulse on Projects nav (1200x720)
sp-checklist-compact.png — checklist modal anchored to Projects (540x320)
sp-emptystate-keys.png — Keys empty state with suggested CTA and tip bubble
sp-tooltip-variantA.png — short microcopy variant A for tooltip
sp-tooltip-variantB.png — short microcopy variant B for tooltip with privacy-first phrasing
decisions: Keep initial checklist to 3 items: Create project, Add API key, Try playground — reduces cognitive load
Use small animated pulse (Lottie) rather than full-screen coach to respect user's focus and reduce friction
Default to collapsed checklist with progressive disclosure to avoid blocking power-users
Accessibility: all pulses must include prefers-reduced-motion fallback and visible focus ring for keyboard users
Localization: microcopy variants curated to fit 120–140 characters in English with allowances for expansion
next_steps: Finalize microcopy: choose between Variant A (direct action) and Variant B (privacy-first) — awaiting PM vote
Export Lottie and optimized SVGs to Drive, include 2 sizes for mobile/desktop
Handoff tokens: provide color/spacing tokens to frontend (primary-accent, pulse-radius, tooltip-shadow)
Schedule 30-min sync with Eng for anchor behavior and z-index constraints (requested by @eng-ux)
QA checklist: keyboard nav, screen reader labels, motion preference behavior
acceptance_criteria: Design assets (Figma frames + export zip) uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket
Two microcopy variants delivered and annotated for i18n reviewers
Prototype demonstrates pulse animation, opening checklist, and CTA navigation to 'Create project'
Front-end implements reduced-motion and keyboard-focus states per accessibility notes
PM sign-off recorded on Confluence and PR ready for merge
accessibility_notes: Pulse animation defaults to a single gentle loop, but respects prefers-reduced-motion: in reduced-motion mode, replace animation with a static halo and add aria-describedby on the anchor node. Tooltips must have role=dialog and clear focus management. Color contrast for pulse halo must be >= 4.5:1 against the background. Ensure text alternatives exist for Lottie where applicable.
